title: How to Paint a Colorful Year in 72 Hours—Art Tutorial
editorial_title: A year batched in 72 hours: tools, timelines, CAPTCHA, ads, and paper dialogue
summary: A 6:34 process monologue rather than a conventional painting tutorial. Tool envy yields an inside-you refrain; the speaker claims one annual 72-hour studio batch becomes a year of edited releases, avoids social/electronics and trusts a team, jokes about telepathic texts and multiple Earth time streams, satirizes AI/job fear through CAPTCHA, proposes blocking senses, personifies paper/trees, interrupts himself with a Monk Bags ad, speculates about inner-teen and unhoused self-talk, discloses sleep/reality difficulty, and reconciles with the paper through betrayal/help/apology language. All claims, stigma, promotion and vulnerability remain attributed; none becomes production, science, safety, psychology, product or crisis fact.

speaker_policy.status: single process monologue with performed dialogue/ad; identity withheld
speaker_policy.reason: Channel/self-address context suggests David Choe, but captions lack prefix and independently held-out acoustic validation.

chapters.title: Monk Bags ad / uncertain product phrase

connections.relationship: Repeated tool questions set up the inside-you refrain.
A claimed annual 72-hour session explains later segmented releases.
Self-blocking and team trust separate creation from distribution.
Footage cutting becomes a multiple-time-stream metaphor.
A CAPTCHA makes the human prove identity to a robot.
Noise and sensory blocking are proposed as creative constraints.
Paper’s lack of eyes is countered with sentient-tree rhetoric.
A product ad interrupts the inside-you/material philosophy.
The speaker identifies an angry teenage inner addressee.
Unhoused self-talk is speculatively mapped to past relationships.
The monologue moves from theory to current-seeming personal difficulty.
Paper becomes a betrayed/helping partner in a reconciliation scene.

source_notes: All 61 raw caption records remain aligned exactly once.
Tool, Earth-616, alive/CAPTCHA and regularly scheduled receive supported repairs.
Textathy, product phrase and cold-press ending remain unresolved or qualified.
72-hour/year/editing chronology remains self-report, not production proof.
Sensory blocking is not a complete/safe protocol.
Trees hearing/seeing and inner materials remain personification/metaphor.
Monk Bags language is embedded ad copy; availability/material claims are unverified.
Unhoused/self-talk theory and crazy framing remain speaker generalization, not psychology.
Sleep/reality difficulty remains dated self-report, not diagnosis/current crisis status.
Zero named turns or enrollment windows.
